title: Three white lattice structure diagrams with captions
objects_and_counts: Three distinct 3D-rendered lattice assemblies are visible, arranged left-to-right across the image: one on the left, one in the centre, and one on the right.
No people are visible in the image.

Each lattice assembly consists of multiple white rod-like strands forming grid patterns; the centre assembly appears as a denser dual-layer grid, the right assembly appears as two separated layers (sandwich-like), and the left assembly appears as a blended single-layer lattice.
There are three textual headings/captions associated with the three assemblies (one for each assembly).
A soft pale blue-to-white gradient background is visible behind the three rendered objects.

Each lattice object sits roughly centered within its horizontal panel and casts a subtle shadow on the gradient background beneath it.

The main heading-level texts ('Blending structure' and 'Layer-by-layer structure') appear above their respective left and centre objects; the lower captions ('Dual layer structure' and 'Sandwich-like structure') are placed beneath the centre and right objects respectively.
There are no arrows or connecting lines between the three panels; they are displayed side-by-side with visual spacing separating them.
